slides.h: Five things that make a room read cheap.
slides.dek: None of them are about money. Every fix inside costs little or nothing.

body: Shiny tiles, shiny paint, shiny plastic. Glare is the fastest tell in a room.
**The fix:** matte and satin finishes wherever you get to choose. Flat paint, honed stone, raw wood.
A single ceiling bulb flattens every face and every surface under it.
**The fix:** three sources at three heights. Floor lamp, table lamp, candle. Ceiling light stays off after sunset.
A small rug drifting in the middle of the floor shrinks the whole room around it.
**The fix:** big enough that the front legs of every seat sit on it. When in doubt, size up.
Sofa, loveseat, chair and table from one showroom photo. It reads like a catalogue, not a home.
**The fix:** one wood, one metal, one fabric. Agreeing on tone, arriving from different places.
Cool white light after dark makes a living room feel like a clinic.
**The fix:** warm white, 2700 to 3000 kelvin, in every socket a guest can see.
Matte over gloss. Low warm light over bright. Pieces that agree over pieces that match. That is most of the look, and none of it is a price tag.

slides.h: Save this before you buy one more thing.
